name: Allgemeine Sozialberatung
helps_with: First point of contact for any social or money problem: poverty, applying for benefits (Bürgergeld, Wohngeld, Kindergeld), forms and letters from authorities, not knowing where to turn.
says: I don't know who can help me
I can't fill out this form from the Jobcenter
We don't have enough money for food
I need help applying for Wohngeld

name: Schuldner- und Insolvenzberatung
helps_with: Debts, unpaid bills, loans, rent arrears, bailiff (Gerichtsvollzieher), account seizure (Pfändung), private insolvency.
says: I can't pay my bills anymore
The bailiff sent me a letter
My bank account was frozen
I have too many loans

name: Suchtberatung
helps_with: Adults with problems with alcohol, drugs, medication, gambling or gaming, and their partners and relatives.
says: My husband drinks every day
I can't stop gambling
I think I'm addicted to painkillers

name: Suchtberatung für Jugendliche
helps_with: Teenagers and young people with alcohol, cannabis, drugs or gaming problems, and their parents.
says: My son smokes weed every day
My daughter is drinking at parties
I'm 17 and can't stop gaming

name: Beratung bei Essstörungen
helps_with: Anorexia, bulimia, binge eating, for affected people and their families.
says: My daughter barely eats anything
I throw up after eating

name: Schwangerschaftsberatung
helps_with: Pregnancy (planned or unplanned), financial help during pregnancy, parents of babies and children up to 3 years.
says: I'm pregnant and don't know what to do
We need money for baby things
I just had a baby and feel overwhelmed

name: Erziehungsberatung
helps_with: Parenting questions, conflicts with children or teenagers, school refusal, separation/divorce and the children, family conflicts.
says: My son won't go to school
We argue with our teenager all the time
We're separating, how do we tell the kids

name: Frühförderung
helps_with: Babies and small children (before school) whose development worries the parents: speech, movement, behaviour, disability, premature birth.
says: My 3-year-old still doesn't talk
Our baby was born too early
My child is developing slower than others

name: Familienpflege
helps_with: Help at home running the household and caring for the children when a parent is suddenly ill, in hospital or after birth.
says: I'm going to hospital, who looks after my kids
After the birth I can't manage the household

name: Kuren für Mütter, Väter und pflegende Angehörige
helps_with: Exhausted mothers, fathers or family carers who need a health cure (Mutter-Kind-Kur, Vater-Kind-Kur).
says: I'm completely exhausted as a mother
I care for my mother and I'm burning out
How do I apply for a Mutter-Kind-Kur

name: Kinderkuren und Erholung
helps_with: Health cures, rehabilitation and holiday recovery stays for children.
says: My child needs a cure for asthma
Is there a recovery holiday for my sick child

name: Jugendsozialarbeit
helps_with: Young people (roughly 14-27) with problems at school, finding an apprenticeship or job, school social work.
says: I dropped out of school and don't know what to do
I can't find an apprenticeship

name: Jugendwohnen
helps_with: Supervised housing for young people who need to live away from home for school, training or work.
says: I got an apprenticeship in another city and need somewhere to live

name: Junge Eltern und Berufsausbildung
helps_with: Young parents who want to do an apprenticeship or vocational training while raising a child.
says: I'm a young mother and want to start an apprenticeship

name: Jugendhilfe
helps_with: Children and teenagers who cannot live with their family, residential youth care, help for families in serious difficulty.
says: My child can't live at home anymore
We need help from youth services

name: Hilfen für Frauen in Not- und Gewaltsituationen
helps_with: Women experiencing domestic violence, abuse, threats, or women in an emergency situation without support.
says: My partner hits me
I'm scared of my husband
I need to get away from him with my kids

name: Wohnungslosenhilfe
helps_with: Homelessness, sleeping rough, about to lose the flat (eviction), no fixed address, emergency shelter, Bahnhofsmission.
says: I have nowhere to sleep tonight
I'm being evicted next week
I live on the street

name: Sozialpsychiatrische Dienste
helps_with: People with mental illness (depression, anxiety, psychosis) and their relatives; support in daily life, not an emergency service.
says: I've been depressed for months
My brother has schizophrenia and we don't know how to help
I have panic attacks

name: Krisenhilfe, Telefonseelsorge und Suizidprävention
helps_with: Acute emotional crises, grief, loneliness, someone to talk to day and night, suicidal thoughts.
says: I just need someone to talk to
My wife died and I can't cope
I don't want to live anymore

name: HIV/Aids-Beratung
helps_with: HIV diagnosis, living with HIV/Aids, testing, and support for partners and relatives.
says: I just found out I'm HIV positive

name: Straffälligenhilfe
helps_with: People who were in prison or are on probation, and their families: housing, work, debts after release.
says: I just got out of prison
My husband is in jail, how do we manage

name: Fachambulanz für Sexual- und Gewaltstraftäter
helps_with: Therapy for people who have committed, or fear they might commit, sexual or violent offences.
says: I'm afraid I could hurt someone
I have urges I don't want to act on

name: Flüchtlings- und Integrationsberatung
helps_with: Refugees and migrants: asylum procedure, residence permit, family reunification, language courses, integration, letters from the immigration office.
says: I came from Ukraine and need help with papers
I got a letter from the Ausländerbehörde
How can I bring my family to Germany

name: Rückkehrberatung für Geflüchtete
helps_with: Refugees who want to, or have to, return to their home country: options, financial support, planning.
says: I want to go back to my home country
My asylum was rejected, what are my options

name: Ambulante Pflege
helps_with: Nursing care at home for elderly or sick people (Sozialstation), help with washing, medication, household.
says: My father needs care at home
My mother can't wash herself anymore

name: Tagespflege
helps_with: Day care for elderly people: they spend the day in a centre and go home in the evening; relieves family carers.
says: My mother is alone all day while I work

name: Pflegeheim (vollstationäre Pflege)
helps_with: Nursing home places when care at home is no longer possible.
says: We can't care for grandma at home anymore
Looking for a nursing home place

name: Ambulant betreute Wohngemeinschaften
helps_with: Shared supervised flats for people needing care, especially people with dementia.
says: My father has dementia, is there an alternative to a nursing home

name: Besuchsdienste
helps_with: Volunteers who regularly visit lonely elderly people at home or in care homes.
says: My mother is very lonely
Nobody visits my grandfather

name: Nachbarschaftshilfe
helps_with: Small practical help from neighbours and volunteers: shopping, household, accompanying to appointments, childcare.
says: I need someone to help me with shopping
Who can drive me to the doctor

name: Hospiz- und Palliativbegleitung
helps_with: Accompanying seriously ill and dying people and their relatives, hospice, end-of-life questions.
says: My mother is dying
We need support at the end of life

name: Förderschulen
helps_with: Special needs schools for children with disabilities or learning difficulties.
says: My child has a disability and needs a special school
